name: Geshem
overview: Geshem, also known as Gashmu the Arabian, was a key opponent of Nehemiah during the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls. Scripture records that Geshem, along with Sanballat and Tobiah, mocked and despised the effort (Nehemiah 2:19) and repeatedly sought to intimidate Nehemiah by proposing meetings with hidden intentions to do harm (Nehemiah 6:1-4). Despite their opposition, Nehemiah remained steadfast, refusing to abandon the work God had called him to complete (Nehemiah 6:3).
